quotes.quote: In research tasks performed by professional human experts, using a search engine is only a small part of the process; most of the work involves deep exploration across information-dense webpages.
To address this, we built RISE (Realistic Interactive Search Evaluation) to measure a model's search capabilities on real-world professional tasks.
The results show that M2.5 excels at expert-level search tasks in real-world settings.
For example, across multiple agentic tasks including BrowseComp, Wide Search, and RISE, M2.5 achieved better results with fewer rounds, using approximately 20% fewer rounds compared to M2.1.
Effective tool calling and search are prerequisites for a model's ability to autonomously handle more complex tasks.
RISE: Internal benchmark. Contains real questions from human experts, evaluating the model's multi-step information retrieval and reasoning capabilities when combined with complex web interactions.
A Playwright-based browser tool suite is added on top of the WebExplorer (Liu et al., 2025) agent framework.
BrowseComp: Uses the same agent framework as WebExplorer (Liu et al., 2025). When token usage exceeds 30% of the maximum context, all history is discarded.
在人类专家真实的搜索任务中，使用搜索引擎只是一小部分，更多的是在专业网页内进行深度探索。
为此我们构建了 RISE（Realistic Interactive Search Evaluation），用于衡量模型在真实专业任务上的搜索能力。
结果表明 M2.5 在真实世界的专家级搜索任务上表现卓越。
例如，在 BrowseComp、Wide Search 和 RISE 多项任务中，M2.5 以更低的轮次消耗取得了更优的效果，相较于 M2.1 节省了大约 20% 的轮次消耗。
MiniMax M2.5: 更快更强更智能，为真实世界生产力而生 2026-02-12
RISE: 内部基准测试。包含人类专家真实的提问，考察模型结合复杂网页交互时的多步信息搜寻和推理能力。
在 WebExplorer（Liu et al. 2025）的智能体框架基础上加入了基于 PlayWright 的浏览器使用工具集。
BrowseComp: 使用了与 WebExplorer（Liu et al. 2025）相同的智能体框架。每当 token 用量超过 32k 的时候，我们对历史上下文进行总结。最多 token 用量为 1M。

In research tasks performed by professional human experts, using a search engine is only a small part of the process; most of the work involves deep exploration across information-dense webpages. To address this, we built RISE (Realistic Interactive Search Evaluation) to measure a model's search capabilities on real-world professional tasks.

RISE: Internal benchmark. Contains real questions from human experts, evaluating the model's multi-step information retrieval and reasoning capabilities when combined with complex web interactions. A Playwright-based browser tool suite is added on top of the WebExplorer (Liu et al., 2025) agent framework.
Effective tool calling and search are prerequisites for a model's ability to autonomously handle more complex tasks.
